verdict.rationale: Recruitee lists an 'AI & Automation' feature and supports webhooks that fire HTTP POST requests when events occur, which enables some background/event-driven automation, but there is no documentation describing autonomous rule-based workflows, triggers/actions builder, or scheduled automations running independently of an external listener. Missing for 10: details on what 'AI & Automation' actually automates, evidence of a native automation/workflow builder, and confirmation that automations execute without requiring an external webhook consumer.
